note: Tasks written WITHOUT inspecting either corpus -- no scouting for skills that happen to exist. Each task has an objectively checkable answer: `must_include` lists tokens a correct answer requires (exact flags, function names, formats, commands). Deterministic grading removes judge bias and costs no model quota. `all_of` groups mean: at least one token from each group must appear.
